Nora: Heads-up 10: AtlasHealth asked for a lightweight pilot of an 'Optimize Toolkit' to help them cut inference cost while keeping clinical quality.

Diego: Can you summarise their primary must-haves?

Nora: From their email: 1) per-model quant recommendations (with rollback checks), 2) route-aware batching suggestions (mobile-aware), 3) intelligent prefix/KV caching recommendations + conservative TTLs, 4) eval-triggered alerts tied to their prompt suites, 5) a simple API/CLI to gate CI.

Leah: They keep repeating "no silent quality regression". We'll need a clear eval flow and a conservative default.

Ravi: Proposed MVP scope (6 wks): API + CLI only, no UI. Deliverables: recommendation API, ri-optimize CLI (suggest/check), eval-alerts webhook sink, sample runbook, and a short pilot onboarding doc.

Nora: Pilot acceptance criteria draft: a) integrate with Atlas + 1 internal app, b) >=15% token-cost drop on at least one route vs baseline OR latency improvement without >1.5% drop in main eval metric, c) eval-alerts correctly detect injected regressions in canary tests, d) docs + CLI, e) no production incidents from toolkit.

Diego: Add an SLO: recommendation API 95p < 300ms for cached responses, 99p < 800ms for cold.

Leah: For quant suggestions we must include explicit validation steps: recommended quant profile, expected token-cost delta, expected p95 change, and an automated eval checklist to run before opt-in.

Ravi: Telemetry needed: per-route seq-length histogram, per-token cost estimate (we can infer from model + profile), per-request p50/p95 latency. Make these opt-in for customers with PHI.

Nora: Security note: default = no user-level caching for any channel marked PHI or PII. Customer must opt-in and confirm retention KMS.

DesignBot: Design can scope a minimal UI after pilot; for now we can provide a simple JSON response shape and example CLI output.

Diego: Example API response shape (sketch):
```
{
  "route": "/patient-summary",
  "timestamp": "2026-06-01T14:22:00Z",
  "profiles": [
    {"key":"low-latency","label":"Low-latency","est_p95_ms":"120","est_token_cost_pct":"-10","notes":"good for short prompts"},
    {"key":"balanced","label":"Balanced","est_p95_ms":"240","est_token_cost_pct":"-20","notes":"recommended for summarization"},
    {"key":"quality","label":"High-quality","est_p95_ms":"420","est_token_cost_pct":"+6","notes":"run eval-suite before enabling"}
  ],
  "checks": ["run-eval --suite clinical-stability","smoke-run --staging --route /patient-summary"]
}
```

Leah: CLI example: `ri-optimize suggest --route /patient-summary --model llama-2-13b` returns the same structure + a small shell script to run checks.

Ravi: Eval-alert flow: periodic run of their prompt suites -> diff scoring (metric delta + direction) -> alert if delta exceeds threshold. We should let customers tune thresholds per-suite.

Nora: Acceptance test plan (automated): 1) capture baseline eval on staging, 2) apply recommended profile to staging-only, 3) run eval-suite to measure delta, 4) assert delta within allowed bounds.

Diego: Operational hooks: webhook sink + slack integration + PD option. Also include a raw CSV export for customers to keep.

Leah: Deployment mode for pilot: Hosted API + customer runs CLI against our API. For Private customers we'd ship the agent but pilot is hosted.

Ravi: Resource estimate: 2 engs infra (runtime telemetry + API) + 1 infra-sre + 1 product + 0.5 design for docs, 6 weeks.

Nora: Risks: silent quality loss from quantization, customers misconfiguring caching, noisy eval-alerts. Mitigations: conservative defaults, required eval runs before enabling, clear rollback steps.

Diego: Rollback guide must be explicit: how to revert quant profile, clear timeline for cache TTLs, and test commands to verify parity.

Leah: For Atlas specifically: they use sensitive clinical prompts and prefer a co-browse session vs a UI. Offer a live CLI walkthrough instead of UI in pilot.

Nora: Negotiation note: Atlas asked for model-family presets for LLaMA/OPT/T5. We propose starting with heuristics for those 3 families and call them "presets"; follow-up work to expand.

Ravi: Data retention & PHI: mandate that any cached prefixes be encrypted and have TTL <= 24h unless customer approves longer via compliance flow. Document KMS guidance.

DesignBot: We'll prepare a single sample report PDF showing before/after cost + eval delta for the co-browse.

Diego: Next actionable items:
- Leah: draft PRD + pilot acceptance doc (EOW)
- Ravi: scope telemetry opt-in + impl plan with eng-infra (sync tomorrow)
- Nora: draft customer onboarding email + runbook for co-browse
- DesignBot: sample report + CLI output mocks (next Tue)

OpsBot: Backlog: pilot-optimize-toolkit created and assigned to Nora. :white_check_mark:

Leah: Any objections to ship API+CLI only for MVP?

Diego: +1

Ravi: +1

Nora: +1. I'll post updated acceptance doc when ready and ping Atlas to schedule the co-browse after that.

Leah: I'll also add the automated smoke commands to the PRD so Atlas can run them in CI.

Diego: Thanks all. We'll keep the UI ask as stretch.
